working_definition: Mip (myoinhibitory peptide) neurons as named by the authors.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any adult neuron that expresses Mip (FBgn0036713).

justification: Authors name Mip neurons; adult-specific Mip neuron term is the exact class.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Adult Myoinhibitory peptide-expressing neuron with an anterior soma in the lateral protocerebrum, at the base of the medulla; 3 cells per hemisphere (Kolodziejczyk et al., 2011; Min et al., 2016).
